leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue component that stores JWT tokens in localStorage
Configure a Vue method to retrieve and decode JWT tokens from storage
Apply token validation logic to check JWT expiration before use
Integrate decoded JWT payload data into Vue component state
Construct a secure logout function that removes JWT tokens from storage
Initialize Vue component lifecycle hooks to automatically handle token storage on login
Render user information from decoded JWT payload in the component template
